title: Dependency map layout
responsibility: Places units in dependency layers and builds deduplicated connecting edges.

inputs.name: mapColumns.count
inputs.description: Unit count used to choose a row width.

inputs.name: harnessLayout.units
inputs.description: Units and their declared dependencies to lay out.

inputs.name: harnessLayout.perRow
inputs.description: Optional units per row, defaulting to mapColumns for the supplied count.

outputs.name: nodeSize
outputs.description: Node dimensions of 176 by 34, with horizontal gap 16 and vertical gap 46.

outputs.name: mapColumns
outputs.description: Ceiling of the square root of 0.75 times count, clamped between six and 24.

outputs.name: harnessLayout
outputs.description: Nodes grouped by dependency depth and sorted by identifier within layers, wrapped into rows, with dimensions and one edge per known dependency pair. Cycle traversal is bounded and missing dependency nodes are ignored.
